newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pan Pacific Asia in special stock issue.
newsitem.headline: Pan Pacific Asia in special stock issue.

text.p: Pan Pacific Asia Bhd said on Friday that is proposing a special issue of 4.46 million new shares at 5.70 ringgit a piece to Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) investors.
In a statement, the investment holding firm said the proposed issue is to comply with the Malaysian government's policy to have a minimum of 30 percent Bumiputera ethnic content in companies.
Proceeds arising from the proposed issue amounting to 25.42 million ringgit will be used for working capital purposes, it said.
Following the issue, Pan Pacific said its share capital will be increased to 133.04 million from 128.58 million.
